newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian broker Coen Campos Venuti suspended.
newsitem.headline: Italian broker Coen Campos Venuti suspended.

text.p: The Italian Treasury, at the request of stockmarket watchdog body Consob, has suspended Italian licensed broker Coen Campos Venuti & C Sim for four months.

The board of the brokerage was also suspended and a commissioner Arturo Sanguinetti appointed to run the group. The suspension was decided on Thursday with a ministerial decree and announced by Consob on Friday.

The suspension of the medium-sized licensed broker, or Sim, was for a number of reasons including bad management, the illegal transfer of funds and for ignoring client instructions, Consob told Reuters.
